notes.title: Dev Log #5
notes.content:
Dear Contestants,
We're excited to announce that our major July update (v0.7) has been released! To give you a clearer picture of what to expect, we've broken down the key updates into sections, just like in our previous developer logs.

[list]
[*] New Character: Rose
[*] Assistant
[*] Tour Match Mode
[*] Other Updates
[/list]

[h2]New Character - Rose[/h2]
As you might have already spotted the new character in-game. A file mentioned Mirage Media's announcement of a new, sweet-looking rookie rock singer to be launched soon. Let’s learn more about the character's personality and story in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/4741a82707ba391ba1dbe8b6cb324d40c8cc12bf.png[/img]

Rose's signature weapon is a long spear styled like an electric guitar. Her normal attacks are a five-hit combo that builds up to two charges. Spend one charge for a quick two-hit thrust, or spend both for a powerful three-hit sweep.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/a406663086c895ccd54a33e0b1ddf56cb0d2d18b.png[/img]

Rose's heavy attack packs a punch with four hits and grants a normal attack charge on hit. It also charges up, allowing for powerful combos. Her ultimate is a rapid 11-hit combo, and her dodge can be charged for extra mobility.
Charging is key to maximizing her damage and versatility.

[h2]Assistant[/h2]
You might have heard Match Assistant, one of the Drivers once in game back in the old days. After being built in-game, the accompanying small robot would fire tracking missiles at enemies, causing AoE damage, slowing them down, or speeding up/healing players. However, we soon realized that as an in-game roguelike element, it had limitations such as insufficient synergy with other Drives and slightly weaker overall performance. Therefore, we've decided to phase it out for now and introduce a new sponsor, "Mirage Media" - the [Clone Stream] - to take its place.

Players have always enjoyed the companionship of "pets" in different games. To keep the beloved “Match Assistant” in the game, we've turned it into a pretty unique feature. This not only enhances the assistant's role but also provides players with more strategic options for in-battle Drive selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/f8f20439fcbd20b4ddb1125c6b2af36e1c0984a2.jpg[/img]

There are currently three types of the Match Assistant, each providing different battle assistance: Pioneer (offensive), Guard (defensive), and Nurse (healing). The Pioneer's core skill is firing tracking missiles at enemies every few seconds, dealing tech damage. The Nurse continuously heals all friendly units in the vicinity. The Guard can taunt all nearby enemies for a certain duration, but will cancel the taunt prematurely if its health reaches zero.

Match Assistants can be upgraded through an in-game "Support System." During battles, as players build their abilities by selecting Drives, Relics, and other elements, they earn a certain amount of Match Assistant experience. Each level-up grants a talent point that can be used to unlock nodes in the Assistant's talent tree, significantly boosting its abilities. It's important to note that the talent tree resets after each battle, allowing players to experiment with different talent builds in subsequent battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/14c79ab778e2b68b010c3e7959b96a336bafa57e.png[/img]

 Outside of battles, players can enhance their Match Assistant by obtaining star-up items for their specific model, which can be earned through the Tour Match. Additionally, players can install and upgrade chips to boost the Assistant's attributes. Chips provide extra abilities for the Assistant and start with a single slot. More slots can be unlocked by consuming Micro Components, with a maximum of four. Chips can also be upgraded using Micro Components to gain more powerful effects. Micro Components can also be used to reset chips, allowing players to reroll for more desirable effects. To streamline this process, "Lock" and "Direct" items can be used to more efficiently enhance chip abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/375a5780594c9e440bd3978af4ab1f0b8e0df149.png[/img]

[h2]Tour Match[/h2]
The Tour Match is a new and exciting feature that consists of multiple rooms or levels, each offering unique gameplay experiences. You can team up with friends to conquer these levels together or challenge yourself in solo play and try to set new records.
We've added Shops and Fusion Drive Consoles to each stage, making it easier for you to purchase and combine Drives. Additionally, upon completing specific objectives within each room, you'll be rewarded with treasure chests. These chests contain various rewards for you to choose from.
The Tour Match features several different room types, including:

[b]Battle Room:[/b]
Enemies, both normal ones and elites, will spawn randomly throughout the room. Defeating elite enemies alone won't clear the room; you must eliminate all enemies to progress.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/2e53d9c7aa31e25c6c0836b1126a79020d5e0dc3.png[/img]

[b]Mini-Game Room:[/b]
Tour Match introduces new mini-game mechanics, such as escorting a target to a specific location within a time limit or preventing monsters from entering a designated area. Successfully completing these objectives will yield greater rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/8e6a516aacd68bbc5d6ff65edceeeb329c03551e.png[/img]

[b]Boss Room:[/b]
With every few levels successfully passed, players will encounter a boss room. You may need to defeat regular enemies before the boss appears. Upon defeating the boss, you'll not only progress to the next level but also get a chance to spin the "Touring Roulette" for additional rewards, such as Drives or Tier 4 Relics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/7ba4a392aba6c8f54f3682c737479ed975a9818e.png[/img]

[h3]Touring Roulette:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/ec0533f7a39c84660c02d8ee56e7177d1d645a5b.png[/img]

Upon defeating the boss in a boss room, players will encounter a "Touring Roulette". Players will receive a certain number of free spins. Each spin will randomly award a prize from the wheel, and the awarded item will be removed from the wheel for subsequent spins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/f3ccd1001c8a11133f343efddaa0883419898bc3.png[/img]

Once you've exhausted your free spins, you can use keys to get additional spins and claim the remaining prizes. Keys can be obtained by participating in Breaking Show or Team Match. Additionally, the Touring Roulette features a "Critical Hit" mechanic, giving players a chance to double their rewards on any given spin! Furthermore, players can use up to two "Prize Bans" per spin to exclude specific prizes from the reward pool. However, the total number of Prize Bans per Circuit Tour is limited, so use them wisely.


[h3]Match Preparation:[/h3]
Match Preparation is a crucial part of the Tour Match, consisting of two primary functions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/0af1b203bd89a80b6d5383f0f9be8b9e06663d13.png[/img]

The first major function ist preparation, which is divided into two categories: Supply List and Battle List. In addition to the familiar starting rewards like Likes and Refresh Counts, the Supply List also provides effective buffs for the Touring Roulette, such as increasing the chance of a critical hit.
Additionally, as players prepare a certain number of things, they'll unlock the highly anticipated second feature: disabling Drives and Relics. As the number of prepared projects increases, players can disable up to 12 Drivers and 13 Relics of various tiers within a match, significantly increasing the chances of building their desired builds. We hope the Tour Match brings you some fun.

And we have some other Updates: 

-Louder "Seed II" mission: Fixed an issue where clearing the Preliminaries would incorrectly trigger the Qualifiers.
-Simon's weapon customization: Fixed an issue where Heavy ATK 3-1 and Heavy ATK 3-2 could cause an infinite Heavy ATK loop.
-Fragility Space: Fixed an issue where crossing layers in Fragility Space would cause the next layer's enemies to become uncontrollable.
-Privilege of the Strong: Fixed an issue where this perk could not control Aleksi.
-Like Rooms: Fixed an issue where the score could suddenly decrease.
-Prosthesis Basic Set: Fixed an issue where the set effect was not working correctly.
-Prosthesis Enhancement: Fixed an issue where clicking too quickly could cause incorrect attribute display.
-Rookie Agreement: Fixed a text error in the Relic.

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're thrilled to announce the release of v0.6.0, bringing exciting new content and gameplay enhancements to Meta-Ghost: The Breaking Show. We will have a brief introduction of Team Match Difficulty 6 and Prothesis Merge here in our devlog.

[h2]Team Match Difficulty 6[/h2]

Following the exhilarating “Breaking” in Chapter 5, we've now introduced the ultimate challenge for Team Match mode: Difficulty 6! Prepare to face off against formidable bosses like "Father" and "Mother" as you delve into the depths of this intense new difficulty level.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/05b4cc8ff4022c2b21304d48148c66ba50ca9839.png[/img]

But that's not all! In Difficulty 6, you'll also gain access to the "Heat Gate" for +9 Heat, allowing you to push your limits and conquer challenges up to +18 Heat. Brace yourselves for enemies with enhanced attributes, bountiful rewards, and exclusive items that enable the "Attributes Lock" feature.

In response to player feedback, [b]we've streamlined the Heat system in Team Match mode[/b]. Previously, players had to repeatedly clear the same difficulty level to unlock higher Heat levels. Now, when challenging the new Difficulty 6, you can directly access the highest Heat Gate, "+3 Heat," at your discretion.

To further enrich the gameplay experience in Team Match mode Difficulty 6, we've introduced "Match levels" exclusively on Floor 11. In these unique rooms, players will encounter a special objective: defeat hordes of enemies to earn high scores and unlock exceptional rewards.

For a touch of lighthearted fun, we've introduced Mini-Games that lucky players will have the chance to experience. In this current update, we've included two engaging Mini-Games: "Color Maze", its objective is to transform all nine tiles into the same color by strategically stepping on them. Each successful color change earns you points, adding to the excitement of this fast-paced Mini-Game. and "Canine training", you'll take on the adorable task of guiding four colorful puppies to their corresponding color zones. As you skillfully maneuver these furry friends to their designated areas, you'll accumulate points, making Puppy Parade a delightful Mini-Game experience. We're always eager to hear your feedback and suggestions. Feel free to leave a comment below and let us know what you think of our Mini-Games. Your input is invaluable in shaping our future endeavors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/c630d7b5ac7cb3c5c45497679fde4e5b57e584cb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/4471bc2e75940a3485e0cb77036473bf60db0b15.png[/img]
  
[h2]Prothesis Merge[/h2]
As previously announced, Prothesis Merge is a groundbreaking feature that empowers you to replace or upgrade Prothesis attributes, further enhancing your character's abilities. Prothesis Affix encompass two categories: "Secondary Attributes" and "Effects."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/55b0024d4df519b57bd0a8a05e2d4f0fae9294aa.png[/img]
 
To start Prothesis Merge, you will need to have the Main Prothesis, reached its maximum level +12, the Material Prothesis must be at least level +6, the Material Prothesis must belong to the same body part as the Main Prothesis. For instance, if the Main Prothesis is an Alloy Spine, the Material Prothesis must also be an Alloy Spine. With Prothesis Merge, you can get:

[olist]
[*] When fusing a Main Prothesis with a Material Prothesis, if they share the same secondary attribute or effect, there's a chance that the corresponding Affix level of the Main Prothesis will increase. This probability rises in tandem with the level of the corresponding Affix on the Material Prothesis. If the Affix level on the Material Prothesis is strictly higher than the Affix level on the Main Prothesis, the upgrade success rate is guaranteed to be 100%. Please note that each fusion can only increase an affix level by a maximum of 1.

[*] So far, the maximum level for Prothesis Effect is at 3 and for Secondary Attirbute, is at V. As you elevate your Prothesis through Merge, the affix rating will also evolve, reflecting the increasing power of your enhancements. The current maximum affix rating is "Transcendent III," achieved when all secondary attributes reach level V and all effects reach level 3. No longer are you limited by the initial rating of your Prothesis, whether it was "Excellent," "Superb," or "Perfect." Through the power of Prothesis Merge, any Prothesis can be upgraded to the coveted "Transcendent III" rating (The only distinction between Protheses lies in the minimum number of upgrades required to reach "Transcendent III.")

[*] When fusing Protheses with different effects or secondary attributes, the fusion process will randomly select one affix from either the Main Prothesis or the Material Prothesis to retain on the Main Prothesis. This means there's a chance that the desired affix will be preserved, but there's also a chance it will be "overwritten" by the other affix. To safeguard your desired affixes from being overwritten during Prothesis Merge, we highly recommend utilizing the newly introduced Affix Lock feature. 
[/olist]

[h2]Affix Lock[/h2]
Affix Lock feature stands as a crucial tool for safeguarding specific Affix (secondary attributes & effect) during the processes of Prothesis Remake and Prothesis Merge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/b99ec7bcc55bbe3598327305204cc8bd7e672a53.png[/img]
 
[olist]
[*] To be able to use Affix Lock, you will need the item “Feature Screening Card” for which can be obtained via Team Match Difficulty 6 and Breaking Show-Hard (Chapter 5), or you can purchase it from the Store (we have also updated the Store layout)
[*] Whether for Prothesis Remake or Prothesis Merge, you can simultaneously lock a maximum of one secondary attribute ) and one effect per operation. Locking an affix consumes one Feature Screening Card, while locking an effect consumes three. A crucial point to note is that Prothesis Reconstruction only generates effects of levels 1 and 2. notes.title: Major Updates - v0.5.0
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,
It's been a month since the Early Access release of Meta-Ghost: The Breaking Show, and we're incredibly grateful for your attention and support! Over the past month, we've been actively collecting bug reports and suggestions through forms and using them to make daily fixes and optimizations to the game. Additionally, we've released an updated roadmap, which signifies our unwavering commitment to fulfilling our promises and delivering high-quality content. In this v0.5.0 update, we've not only addressed optimizations and bug fixes but also introduced details of these new additions and the motivations behind them.

[u]Please feel free to leave us comments and feedback.[/u]

[h3]Breaking Show Chapter 5[/h3]
- Embark on a new chapter in the main storyline as Chapter 5 of The Breaking Show introduces a fresh battle scene brimming with challenges. 
- Operation system updates.

📢[i]Developer's Notes:
Face off against four new bosses, including Kumeji Hikari from Romani Biosciences, a formidable opponent known for her unpredictable nature and passion for human experimentation and bioweapons. She commands a mechanical monstrosity resembling a "double-headed dragon.
This chapter will also unravel the mysteries surrounding Taisuke's participation in the competition, the intertwined past between Kumeji Hikari and Taisuke, Kumeji Hikari's sinister plot, and the truth behind The Breaking Show. We're committed to crafting a captivating narrative that immerses players in this cyberpunk world, allowing them to witness the past, present, and future of the protagonists. As we move forward, we plan to introduce a random side plot feature to further enrich and refine the storyline and world-building.
To align with the unlocking of the new chapter, this update introduces a new stage in the "operating system," including enhancements related to the number of likes and refreshes at the start of the game. Players are advised to prepare the corresponding amount of computing power.[/i]

[h3]New Heart-Lung Set Effects:[/h3]
1. Anatta [Exclusive to Taisuke]: When Taisuke activates [Unmoving], the Invincible Slash released by Heavy ATK deals Ultimate Damage and is no longer affected by Heavy ATK Damage buffs.
2. Suppression [Exclusive to Jean]: When Jean has [Buffer Shield] active, deploy a Domain that reduces the attack speed and movement speed of enemies within the Domain. Each shield piece reduces enemy speed by 5%. When the shield pieces are ≥5 layers, the Domain range increases and becomes the priority target for enemy attacks.
3. Fullness [Exclusive to Yan]: For each point of Reparium that Yan has, her Basic ATK attack speed and Ultimate Final Damage increase by 2%. When Reparium >10 layers, there is a 20% chance to heal herself and allies when Basic ATK and Ultimate hit.
4. Rebirth [Exclusive to Yan]: When Yan releases her Ultimate, she revives teammates on the battlefield who are in a near-death state. If no teammates are near death, she increases the attack power of all allies by 10% for 8 seconds.
5. Hot Wind [Exclusive to Simon]: When Simon uses [Thermal Shot+], he gains Super Armor and generates a strong wind around his body every second, knocking back enemies and destroying flying bullets.
6. Devotion [Exclusive to Simon]: When Simon's Heavy ATK hits a single enemy, the base damage is increased by 100% and the weapon heat is reduced by 10 points.
7. Unrestrained [Exclusive to Simon]: Simon's Dash Charge +1, [Thermal Shot+] and [Smoke Revolver+] base damage +30%.
8. Raucous [Exclusive to Simon]: When Simon enters Overheat, [Thermal Shot+] explodes when it hits enemies, dealing 400% Basic ATK damage and emptying weapon heat after 1 second.

[h3]Adjustment to Other Set Effects:[/h3]
1.Instinct [Exclusive to Taisuke]: After Taisuke uses Heavy ATK, he gains "Resolve": Heavy ATK Final Damage is increased by 5% for 3 seconds. When "Resolve" is stacked 3 times, he gains "Instinct": Attack is increased by an additional 15%, Basic ATK attack speed and Heavy ATK attack speed are increased by an additional 10%.
2.Frenzy [Exclusive to Jean]: When Jean is attacked, she gains 10 Excitement Points and "Adrenaline": Attack is increased by 10%, stackable up to 3 layers, for 7 seconds.
3.Healing [Exclusive to Yan]: When Yan consumes Reparium, if there are players on the field with HP below 50%, she will additionally heal them once and return the Reparium consumed this time.
4.Protection [Exclusive to Yan]: When Yan consumes Reparium to heal, additionally add a shield equal to 5% of their HP to players with HP above 80%, which can be stacked 6 times, for 3 seconds.
5.Photosynthesis [Exclusive to Yan]: Yan's Photon Energy Reserve recovery speed is increased by 50%, and during Heavy ATK, she can recover Photon Energy Reserve at a base rate of 3 points/second.

📢[i]Developer's Notes:
Given that the Heart-Lung Prothetic is a set of prosthetics that can almost directly change the way a character is played, we fully understand everyone's eagerness to try out the cool power of Legendary set or ,have more set choices (especially for players who like to use the character "Simon"). Core Implants have not only been updated to Legendary quality but also added new Core Implants set effects, including a total of 8 sets including exclusive sets for each participant, which can bring more different builds to each character. For example, Taisuke's "Unmoving" build, and the auxiliary builds of Jean and Yan, can all become possible with the support of the new sets.[/i]

[h3]Targeted Prosthetic Exchange[/h3]
The v0.5.0 update introduces a groundbreaking feature: the Custom License. This coveted item grants players the ability to designate a primary attribute during Prosthetic Assembly, empowering them to tailor their prosthetics to their exact preferences.
Custom License Acquisition
Currently, the Custom License can be primarily acquired through store, offering players a convenient means to obtain this valuable resource. In the future, as new difficulty levels are introduced for Team Battles, the Custom License may also be included among the rewards, providing an additional avenue for players to acquire this coveted item.

📢[i]Developer's Notes:
The ability to specify a primary attribute during Prosthetic Assembly has been a highly requested feature among players, as it holds the potential to significantly enhance the Looting experience. In response to this overwhelming demand, we prioritized the development of this functionality and are thrilled to introduce it in this update. We hope that the Custom License will empower players to achieve their desired Prosthetic configurations more efficiently, propelling them towards their ultimate Looting goals.[/i]

[h3]Expanded Vending Machine Functionality:[/h3]
1.Material and Chip Exchange: Players can now sell Alloy Materials and Conversion Chips in exchange for Computing Power. This Computing Power can then be used to purchase Conversion Chips.

📢[i]Developer's Notes:
We have observed that players have a need to exchange a larger quantity of materials for a smaller quantity at different stages. Therefore, we have launched the "Resource Trading" function to meet the needs of players to quickly obtain the required materials.
In addition, we have also added rare items that can be exchanged for ordinary materials in this store, providing players with more convenient and fast choices, allowing them to unleash the maximum value of every material they obtain after overcoming difficulties.[/i]

[h3]Extreme Racing:[/h3]
[b]Event Period: After v0.5.0 update ~ June 9, 2024, 23:59(UTC0)[/b]

To celebrate the May major update v0.5.0, the Extreme Racing event will be launched. In "Breaking Show - Breaking Race (Chapter 5)", a new "Extreme Racing" mode will be added. During the event, the Breaking Show clearance time leaderboard will be open. Each character's "Extreme Racing" clearance record will be entered into their own leaderboard (a total of 4 leaderboards for Taisuke, Jean, Yan, and Simon). The shorter the time, the higher the ranking. After the event ends, the top 10 players in each character's leaderboard will be recorded as a side story and permanently preserved in the game's side story and story collection. In addition, the "Extreme Racing" mode will also be converted into a permanent "Difficult" mode. notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are here to share some details about the adjustments of enhancement system and online-co mode with you through this dev log.

First and foremost, we'd like to inform everyone that our game, 'Meta-ghost: Prologue,' officially launched on 2/29. Compared to the demo version, it includes all the out-of-game development and online-co mode gameplay. Additionally, a brand-new Driver named “Mirage Media” and many new relics have been added. Furthermore, the progress made during this prologue will carry over to the official version. So, feel free to immerse yourself in the experience!

[b]Key words:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Operating System
[*] Weapon customization
[*] Prosthetic weaponing
[*] Suits
[*] Team Matches
[*] Rankings[/b]
[/list]

As a game that combines Rouge-lite and looter, 'Meta-ghost: The breaking show' not only focuses on in-game builds but also emphasizes player growth outside the races. Therefore, we provide a rich out-of-game enhancement system, allowing everyone to have a smoother experience and a more splendid performance in the 'Breaking Show.'

[h2]Operating System[/h2]

The operating system is a shared enhancement similar to a skill tree for all participants. The enhancements include not only numerical growth such as increased attack power, maximum health, critical hit rate, but also special functions like extra revives, additional shop refreshes, etc.

The operating system consumes 'Computing Power' items for upgrades, and Computing Power is distributed based on the comprehensive performance of participants in any race settlement, combined with the current race's performance. (Even if a participant unexpectedly withdraws, they can still obtain a small amount of Computing Power.) The operating system is divided into multiple unlock stages, and new stages are unlocked as participants complete a certain number of upgrades."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/04e63bad2ed23e07a5821e65a02298042709ef0c.png[/img]

[h2]Weapon customization[/h2]

Although each controllable character currently seems to have only one type of weapon, the official weapon customization system allows for the customization of different parts of the weapon (corresponding to different skills of the character). This modification changes the participant's basic combat style and various skills, leading to the evolution of different gameplay.

The system uses "Augmentation Chips," which are data chips containing weapon customization protocols stored internally. These chips are rarer compared to Computing Power and are usually awarded as prizes for defeating various formidable enemies within the races.

Each weapon (i.e., each character) has four modification slots corresponding to normal attack, heavy attack, defense/evade, and ultimate skill. Each slot has three layers of modifications, and from each layer, one option can be activated. When any modification in a particular slot and layer is activated, the remaining modifications for that slot and layer (the other two options) will be unlocked simultaneously. Moreover, these modifications can be freely switched outside of the races.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/a9dba1f6893f501dc483bdb1bd27eeb2e4f0751a.png[/img]

For example, the participant "Toxin" Taisuke can use the weapon customization "One Mind" to transform the heavy attack into the "Spinning slash," which resembles throwing shurikens, rather than performing a three-stage heavy attack. Another weapon customization, "Immovable," can directly change the heavy attack into a small "Invincible Slash" similar to a special move. When combined with other modifications that increase attack speed or quickly obtain the Samsara Seal, a skill cycle centered around a powerful heavy attack can be created.


Participants should also be aware that for modifications of different levels within the same slot, the unlocking of the next level can only occur after completing the unlocking of the preceding level. Moreover, modifications at different levels in different slots do not affect each other. In addition, all weapon customizations can be rolled back, and 100% of the consumed Augmentation Chips can be refunded. (Of course, participants cannot roll back lower-level modifications while retaining higher-level ones.) Therefore, even in the early stages of the game when Augmentation Chips are scarce, everyone can confidently try unlocking different weapon customization combinations and gradually explore the character styles and strategies that suit them best.

[h2]Prosthetic weaponing[/h2]

Prosthetic weaponing is similar to equipment systems in other games. Here, participants can equip Prosthetic weaponing obtained to significantly enhance their character's attributes and gain unique effects. By successfully challenging specific difficulties in the Breaking Show (single-player mode) and all difficulties in team matches (online-co mode), and successfully defeating the boss in the levels, participants can obtain randomly dropped Prosthetic weaponing. Prosthetic weaponing is categorized by quality colors from low to high: green, blue, purple, and orange (only the first three qualities are included in the prologue version). Higher-quality Prosthetic weaponing usually have more special effects, such as:
(1)Starting from blue quality, each prosthetic weaponing will have a randomly assigned special effect; choosing the right effect can often greatly enhance your racing experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/e1b187af5415ccf1ee514e46938504666139da89.png[/img]

(2)Starting from purple quality, Prosthetic weaponing will have set effects, divided into Enhancing Implant Effects (4-piece set) and Core Implant Effects (2-piece set); set effects can help participants build their builds faster in-game. For example, some set effects have the convenient function of "gaining a designated driver type at the start of the race."

(3)Orange quality Prosthetic weaponing (which will not appear in this prologue) are usually exclusive sets tailored for participants by race organizers and sponsors. The effects of these sets often provide extremely powerful enhancements to specified participants. For example, the set effect "All Cuts," tailor-made for Taisuke, can grant him a super powerful effect: "During the ultimate skill enhancement period, each use of the heavy attack extends the duration of the ultimate skill enhancement."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/fe5909548e82618e64a2a1cacf8efc469eeb96ea.jpg[/img]

All Prosthetic weaponing can be enhanced, disassembled, and reset.

Prosthetic weaponing enhancement involves using materials to increase the armament's level, strengthen its main attributes, and randomly unlock a new secondary attribute after reaching certain enhancement levels. In addition to the previously mentioned Computing Power, the resources required for enhancing Prosthetic weaponing include "Ultra-Light Alloy," an item obtained as a reward from level settlements after completing high-difficulty races.

Prosthetic weaponing disassembly is another way to obtain "Ultra-Light Alloy." When participants acquire unwanted armaments, such as those with lower quality or inappropriate main attributes, they can disassemble them from their inventory to obtain enhancement materials for other armaments, making it a renewable resource.

Prosthetic weaponing resetting is a new feature introduced in the prologue version. It allows participants to consume Computing Power and Augmentation Chip items to randomly replace all effects and secondary attributes of a particular armament (without changing the number of secondary attributes). For players relentlessly pursuing the perfect armament, this is a quite challenging feature.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/63d808124412711fc6625208bc63c793df4f0935.png[/img]

[h2]Suits[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/7844ab3a2c6f407a5d108d5de31571bbdd30cf82.png[/img]
Starting from the prologue, we have implemented the long-awaited suit system for players, finally meeting everyone's preferences for different styles of participant outfits. As long as you participate in the Breaking Show (single-player mode) and pass the challenges of each stage for the first time, you can obtain a significant amount of "Universal Coins" as an official event reward. With a certain amount of Universal Coins, you can unlock suits. Hurry up and make your participant the most stylish one in this Breaking Show!

[h2]Team Matches[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/13d69d5341ac1c428597b375160694baf1001ccc.png[/img]
Next, let me introduce the major overhaul in the online online-co mode of this prologue, namely "Team Matches." Team Matches are special levels organized by the event organizers, supporting up to 3 participants in a team. You can form a team through online matchmaking, inviting friends, or entering private rooms.


Firstly, the most significant update in Team Matches this time is that the battle scenes are no longer confined to the arena! Instead, different maps and bosses will be randomly generated based on the current round progress. When you're playing together, you no longer have to worry about aesthetic fatigue with the constant variation in scenery!

Secondly, we have also updated the way rewards are obtained in Team Matches. Participants can choose one of three challenge rewards at the start of each round, including drivers, relics, likes, and more. Additionally, the shop (top left) and the driver aggregation machine (top right) have been retained. At any time outside of battles, participants can buy drivers or Fusion drivers here, providing a one-stop build-building service. Finally, you can fight to your heart's content until you are defeated and clear the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/6f42675e572f636512f6f24cfbfd93a5931a09da.png[/img]

In the prologue version, Team Matches have two difficulty levels. If the accumulated "Heat" is ≥6 when completing difficulty 1, you can unlock difficulty 2. Every time you complete the 3rd, 7th, and 10th rounds of Team Matches, three special Heat Gates will appear. By choosing and entering the corresponding Heat Gate, you can increase the corresponding heat value. Of course, heat values not only unlock the next difficulty but also have various impacts, including increasing the loot from defeating bosses, enhancing enemy strength, and introducing various "event disturbances" to raise the difficulty. The greater the risk, the greater the reward!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/90076c15f3a663c4922daedb953109cb1c8c3c9e.png[/img]

Currently, the Team Matches gameplay has undergone significant optimizations and changes. However, the event organizers are not satisfied with just this. The iterative process for the online online-co mode continues, and we hope everyone can experience the Team Matches gameplay in this prologue version and provide feedback. We look forward to shaping it into its best form before the official launch.

[h2]Ranking[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/f68e236b43ec64466c4a54ab928e32e3493483a8.png[/img]
Lastly, we introduce the newly added ranking system. As a globally popular reality show competition, how could it lack a ranking system showcasing the absolute strength of the participants? If you've played the previous Demo version or participated in earlier Playtest tests, you'll likely remember the ratings and rankings obtained during the event settlement screen. Yes, with the official launch of the ranking system, your challenge difficulty, completion time, and the build styles used in the event will now be accurately recorded and viewable in the ranking system. Whether you are playing solo or bringing friends to challenge, you can participate in the ranking, competing with participants from around the world. Let's see who is the most dazzling rising star in this Breaking Show!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/35dd3ab7fcefff2a1a60314b43991ed1f20a3056.png[/img]

In the next dev log, we plan to bring you a producer interview titled "Where Will the Era of the Where’s the Post-Sequel?" (It's a preview of our future development plans). Stay tuned!

Don't forget to play our game "Meta-Ghost: Prologue" and explore on your own!

notes.content:
Hello, everyone! This is our first developer log, and it's also an opportunity for us to meet for the first time. We will provide detailed introductions based on the following keywords.

[b]Keywords
• Our Team
• In-Game Stats
• In-game Builds
• Out-of-game Progression
• Online-co Mode[/b]

[h2]Our Team[/h2]
Hello, everyone! I'm Mark, the producer of "Meta Ghost: Breaking Show." It's a great honor to introduce our team to all of you.

Currently, our team consists of around 30 people, and the core members have around 10 years of experience in making game. We are a group of avid gamers who have been playing games since our childhood, starting from the NES, arcade machines, game centers, and all the way to internet cafes... We've been playing games throughout our lives until we graduated from university. Fortunately, I got into game making during the rapid growth of the gaming industry in China after graduation. Thanks to the widespread adoption of 4G technology, mobile games boomed as I became a part of the game industry. Since then, I have been primarily involved in mobile game development. I met our lead artist and lead programmer on mobile game projects. We were around the same age with similar experiences, and we were dissatisfied with many aspects of mobile games at that time. Our ambition is to create a game that truly emphasizes gameplay and provides an excellent gaming experience for players. However, it was challenging to achieve this in companies that prioritized commercial goals above all else. So, with the support of investors, we decided to leave stable positions in a large company and create a game that aligns with our vision, focusing on gameplay and experience. At the end of 2022, we formed our team and defined the direction of the game.

The game's theme revolves around a live-streamed reality show called the "Breaking Show," which features human-machine combats. It takes place in a fictive city during the dawn of the cyberpunk era. The game show appears to the eye as a way for ordinary people to achieve social mobility and a popular entertainment program. However, behind this competition lies a massive conspiracy. Whether it's the organizers of the event, the sponsors, or even the contestants played by the players, everyone is part of a grand scheme. We chose this theme because our team members are fans of cyberpunk movies, TV shows, and games. Additionally, the setting of the game reflects the challenges we faced as a team. In the world we have created, the privileged few monopolize resources due to their early advantages, while the general public struggles on the fringes of society. In order to satisfy their desire for entertainment and maintain social order, the privileged elites organize a live-streamed battle-royale competition called "Breaking Show." The participants must seize a chance for survival in this seemingly glamorous but actually brutal and bloody contest... It is also the story of our journey in developing this game and the story of every dream-driven game developer in the current environment.

In terms of gameplay, our goal is to create an accessible and enjoyable online action game. The team members are all enthusiasts of online multiplayer games, and we have been playing them since the early days. However, there are very few online action games in the market that cater specifically to our preferences, which was an important reason for us to develop this game. Furthermore, the core members of our team are relatively older, and our gaming skills may not be as sharp as they used to be. Many excellent action games currently available have high levels of difficulty, and we often find them challenging to play. We wanted to create an action game that suits our own skill level and provides a comfortable gaming experience. By lowering the barrier of entry, we hope to allow more players to enjoy the fun of this genre.

Now, as the game is taking shape, we can't wait to share it with all of you. During the playtest from January 12th to January 26th, we conducted our first round of testing with players. The entire development team is thrilled, and we eagerly await various suggestions and feedback from the early players. Through this process, we hope to involve players in the development of our game.

During the upcoming Steam Next Fest in February, we will also release a demo version of the game. Even if you missed the playtest, you will have the opportunity to experience our game at that time. Currently, our plan is to release an Early Access version within 2024 and continue to develop and improve the game based on the feedback we receive from the community. We hope you will enjoy our game, and we would greatly appreciate any suggestions and feedback you can provide. Your feedback is truly invaluable to us.

P.S. In order to provide you with a better gaming experience, the specific release date for the early access version will be determined based on the feedback we receive from the Playtest and Demo phases.


[h2]In-Game Stats[/h2]
[b]Character Attributes Overview[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/3975aa113424ae46e6ec0657551052d636b289de.jpg[/img]

[b]Likes[/b]
Located in the top right corner of the battle screen, the Like count is the sole currency within the match (battle). It can be used to make in-match purchases of Drivers and Relics.

[b]Battle Rating[/b]
The Battle Rating is divided into six levels: SSS, SS, S, A, B, and C. It represents the level of favorability the audience has towards the contestants (player characters). Engaging in skillful actions and behaviors such as chaining attacks, killing enemies, and evading damage will increase the rating level. Conversely, poor performance will lower the rating. Based on the current rating, the audience will grant corresponding likes to the player each time they defeat an enemy.

[h2]In-Game Builds[/h2]
The in-game builds are various combat effects and attribute bonuses that players acquire after completing each stage within a match. These effects and bonuses can accumulate throughout the match, but they will be reset if the player fails the match.

[b]Prosthetic Drivers[/b]
Similar to the concept of "drivers" for graphics cards, Prosthetic Drivers are software that allows the player's prosthetic hardware to function properly. Installing different Drivers provides different effects to the player's prosthetics. In the game, the available Prosthetic Drivers are provided by the event organizers and sponsors. There are five categories of Prosthetic Drivers: Foundation Industries, Rise Technologies, Awaken Energy, Romani Biosciences, and Assistant Armament. Each category currently has 15 Drivers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/13fe68b3ac26028f23d597a9a82f2e20a89e6d68.jpg[/img]

By selecting different Drivers, players can create their own unique playstyle within the match. These playstyles will have various effects on the player's combat approach.

For example, when you activate the Foundation Industries Regular Driver "Chain Lightning," your attacks have a 40% chance to unleash Chain Lightning. Later, activating "Long-lasting Current" will give Chain Lightning a 30% chance to apply Electrocuted status. Subsequent builds can then focus on enhancing base damage, tech damage, or increasing the probability and duration of Chain Lightning and Electrocuted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/ea5979655a249bef9ee6eda2afb2e6fc0bd28243.png[/img]

In addition, there are special drivers called the Fusion Drivers. Once you acquire six drivers, you can combine drivers of the same category (same color) or two different categories (two colors) at a special console within the match to obtain a powerful Fusion Driver. The effects provided by Fusion Drivers surpass those of regular drivers. Importantly, even after fusion, the effects of the original drivers are retained.

The effects of Fusion Drivers are determined by the combination of categories (colors). Generally, a Fusion Driver formed by a single category (color) will be more powerful than one formed by combining two different colors. For more information on this aspect, besides exploring it yourself, you can also browse the details in the "Database" section within the character's Lounge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/14b1341a7002d314a3df386ea8f29f5cd41674d3.png[/img]

[b]Relics[/b]

"Relics" are items left behind by defeated opponents or enemies in the game. Unlike the direct combat effects provided by drivers, relics typically grant attribute bonuses, additional rewards, and advantages outside of combat upon acquisition. Additionally, some special relics may interact with obtained drivers, while others possess a "Solidification Effect," meaning their effects will persist within the match even if the relic is lost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/25ee74d139f069ccbf8a97cb3a0288cd9780a216.png[/img]

Currently, relics are categorized by quality from low to high: Type I (green), Type II (blue), Type III (purple), and Type IV (orange). The higher the relic's level, the better the effects it provides.

[b]Fate Room[/b]

During the course of the match, players will encounter randomly appearing Fate Rooms. In these rooms, various random events will occur, such as receiving passionate letters from fans, facing challenging trials with lucrative rewards, or encountering a supply station that trades peculiar items. It is up to you to decide whether to play it safe and only obtain a small reward or take some risks for potentially greater returns. Ultimately, the choice between playing it safe or taking risks depends on your preferences.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/ea0a898e79510bc0365abb54610ac4b13cfaffdf.png[/img]

[b]Combat State[/b]

The "Combat State" refers to the psychological state of participants during a match, which typically generates positive effects. It can be obtained through random events in the Fate Rooms, and each Combat State is crucial. Unfortunately, as a psychological state, it is not long-lasting and usually expires after three match stages.


[h2]Out-of-game Progression[/h2]

[b]Operating System[/b]

The Operating System is a shared skill tree that all playable participants have access to. Unlocking and upgrading entries in the skill tree allows you to gain stat growth in attributes such as attack power, maximum health, health regeneration, and special functionalities like extra revival chances or increased refreshes for selecting drivers or visiting the shop. Moreover, as you progress through the challenge mode, more tabs of the skill tree will be unlocked. The Computing Power used by the Operating System is accumulated through the settlement of matches (or unexpected withdrawals) and is distributed as resources outside of the matches, allowing for continuous accumulation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/8d7152c6c993bbee299bbaccc9aa3c0043b08612.png[/img]

[b]Weapon Augmentation[/b]

Currently, each character has only one weapon, but it can be augmented and customized to change the character's basic combat style and various abilities, resulting in different playstyles. The augmentation system utilizes Augmentation Chip, which are data chips that store weapon augmentation protocols. These chips are typically distributed as rewards for defeating various formidable enemies within the match.

Each weapon has four augmentation categories, usually corresponding to Normal Attacks, Heavy Attacks, Defense/Dodge, and Ultimate. Augmentations are divided into three tiers, and you can choose one augmentation per tier. Once you unlock one augmentation in a tier, the remaining augmentations in the same tier will be unlocked simultaneously, allowing you to freely switch between them outside of matches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/dab6e08a6af7b4afad00d97fcb20cf48e8d74a73.png[/img]

When a character's augmentation reaches three times in each category, it usually completely changes the character's skill experience and combat style. For example, in the case of Taisuke “The Toxin” shown in the image below, the weapon augmentation "Unmoving" transforms the Heavy Attack into a powerful "Invincible Slash" similar to his Ultimate skill. When combined with other augmentations that increase attack speed and allow for rapid acquisition of Kesa-marks, a skill loop revolving around the invincible slash can be created.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/69af9592809da9bc7a40778639acbc2adc44d38b.png[/img]

[b]Prosthetic Armaments[/b]

Prosthetic Armaments can enhance the abilities of characters and possess random secondary attributes and effects, similar to equipment systems in other games. By participating in the Preliminaries of the Breaking Show (single-player mode) on difficulty level 3 or team matches on difficulty level 2, and defeating bosses within them, participants can obtain randomly dropped Prosthetic Armaments. The quality of these armaments ranges from green, blue, purple, to orange, with higher-quality armaments having special set effects.

Furthermore, all Prosthetic Armaments can be upgraded and strengthened using resources. In addition to the computational power mentioned earlier, participants will need Ultra-light Alloy, a resource that can be obtained by defeating enemies in high-difficulty matches (i.e., the Preliminaries and team matches on difficulty level 2), as well as through rewards from stage completion and dismantling armaments.

Starting from the blue quality, each piece of Prosthetic Armament will have a random effect. Choosing effects that align with your character's combat style and build strategy can significantly enhance your match experience.

Starting from the purple quality, Prosthetic Armaments will have set effects, divided into Implant Enhancement Effects (4-piece set) and Core Implant Effects (2-piece set). These set effects can help you form your combat style or build more quickly within the match. For example, some set effects may provide the functionality of "receiving a designated class driver at the beginning of the match."

In addition to these armaments, there are also exclusive Prosthetic Armament sets tailored for participants by the event organizers and sponsors. These sets usually provide powerful enhancements to specific participants. For instance, Taisuke's "Minagiri" set grants the effect of "extending the duration of the enhancement each time a heavy attack is used during the Ultimate enhancement period."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365122/1962dcffa356ed8b92eb265205ca7ef2c5c8c14f.png[/img]

[h2]Online-co Mode[/h2]

Lastly, let's talk about the exciting online-co mode in this testing phase, known as the Group Match, in the game "Breaking Show." This mode is a special challenge organized by the event organizers and currently allows up to three participants to team up. It offers a PvE endless challenge experience, where players can form teams through matchmaking, inviting friends, or joining private rooms. There are a total of ten difficulty levels, and the next level unlocks when the accumulated Heat value during battles reaches six or higher.

After completing the 0th, 3rd, and 6th rounds of the Team Matches, four Heat Gates will appear. Players can choose and enter the corresponding gate to increase their Popularity level. Beyond unlocking higher difficulties, increasing the Popularity level has multiple effects. It enhances the rewards obtained from defeating bosses, increases enemy strength, and introduces quirky "event obstacles" during the matches.

[i]The development of the team gameplay is still ongoing, and we encourage everyone to experience it and provide feedback during this playtest. We plan to provide detailed explanations of the multiplayer mechanics and share our future plans for additional gameplay in upcoming developer logs.[/i]
